title: ECL handoff-contract v1
description: One YAML record per directed edge in the Eidolons hand-off graph. Defined by ECL v1.0 §3.

contract_version.description: Matches the ECL spec version this contract targets.

edge_origin.description: ECL v2.1 §3.3. `emitted-request` added v2.2 — a typed request artifact PROPOSEd upward by the sender for the orchestrator to route; the sender's own roster entry keeps `downstream: []`.

schema_ref.description: Relative path to a per-Eidolon JSON Schema validating the payload body.

required_sections.description: For Markdown payloads: header names that MUST be present.

evidence_anchor_required.description: If true, every claim MUST cite path:line.

token_budget_max.description: Maximum tokens_used across any envelope on this edge.

required_handles.description: Handles every envelope on this edge MUST cite.

trust_level.description: Default trust_level for envelopes on this edge.

notes.description: Free-form prose for human readers. REQUIRED when edge_origin = implicit.
